trigger_rule: candidate node type = Evidence AND provenance_tier = P3_UNSUPPORTED_ASSERTION AND the candidate proposes a SUPPORT or REFUTE edge for it

outcomes.RESOLVED: the retry is no longer a decision-path P3; commit it
outcomes.BLOCKED: the retry is still P3; commit the original minus the offending node and its SUPPORT/REFUTE edge
outcomes.RETRY_FAILED: the retry did not parse or had the wrong shape; same fallback as BLOCKED

action_record_fields.original_candidate_hash: sha256 over the proposal the guard judged, sorted keys
action_record_fields.offending_nodes: candidate ids the rule fired on

retry_prompt:
The proposed Evidence item cannot be traced to the patient input or any retrieved record.

Do not treat it as clinical evidence unless a source can be identified.

Revise this graph update using only:
1. information present in the patient input;
2. records actually retrieved by expert agents;
3. explicitly labeled derived reasoning that is NOT used as external evidence.

Return a corrected graph update.
invariants: the raw LLM response is recorded in the invocation ledger before the guard runs and is never modified (§7)
the guard rewrites no content and invents no source (§8.2)
at most one retry per graph update (§8.2)
a committed delta always carries nodes, edges and edit keys (§14 system correctness)
event_vocabulary: unchanged. `EVENT_TYPES` is frozen and the hash chain is built over it, so guard actions are written to guard_actions.jsonl as a separate ledger rather than as new provenance events.
